name: @memoar/monorepo
description: Vendor-neutral cloud archive and memory for AI coding sessions

scripts.build: npm run contracts:check && npm run build --workspace @memoar/server && npm run build --workspace @memoar/web
scripts.test: npm run contracts:check && npm test --workspace @memoar/server && npm test --workspace @memoar/web
scripts.lint: eslint server/src server/test server/libs web/src web/e2e scripts --max-warnings=0
